title: A new view that renders font previews must apply the preview Surface setting
rule: When a new component renders font samples with a view's PreviewSettings (a review panel, a sheet, a strip), bind the same `surface-light` / `surface-dark` class the font list and grid derive from `preview.surface` on the element that paints the background, next to `backgroundColor`. Text color is applied inline from the settings, so without the surface class a color picked for a dark surface lands on the app theme's background. Add a Playwright check that sets Surface Dark with a white text color in the light theme and asserts the view's computed background and sample color.
rationale: E13.3 (#111): the Quick Collection review applied size, spacing and text color but not Surface, so white text picked for a dark surface showed white on white (1:1).
